godbolt_skip: the defect is in the dxr rewriter tool (IDxcRewriter2::RewriteWithOptions), which Compiler Explorer's dxc panes never invoke -- CE only drives ordinary single dxc compiles, so there is no CE surface that can exercise -remove-unused-globals/-remove-unused-functions or reproduce this symptom
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: dxr's unused-declaration removal drops struct PSOutput (unreachable from ps_main) but never considers typedef PSOutput PSPointOutput for removal, since CollectRewriteHelper only tracks VarDecl/FunctionDecl/TagDecl, never TypedefDecl -- leaving a dangling typedef that fails to recompile, exactly as reported. Reproduces on every stable release able to run this exact probe (v1.5.2010 through v1.9.2607) plus main-debug; v1.4.1907/v1.5.2003 are invalid probes (rewriter API/flag unavailable), not clean results.
title: Rewriter : does not remove unused typedef statements and it lead to compile error
